component.name: Hepta
component.summary: Cross-platform Matrix chat and explicit agent collaboration

description.p: Hepta is a cross-platform Matrix client built on the complete Robrix application shell, with an explicit local-first boundary for agent tasks, tools, and approvals.

We even bring some cool new features to the world of Matrix, like our customizable dockable tabs layout that lets you view and interact with multiple rooms or threads simultaneously. This looks just like your favorite multi-tab web browser or programming IDE. Now you can keep tabs on as many conversations as you want, all at once, and Hepta won't jump or jerk the view around while you scroll through your rooms.

Hepta adapts to any screen size without limiting what you can do. Its upstream shell is written in Rust on the Makepad UI toolkit and Project Robius platform abstractions. You can look forward to fast startup and a fluid experience on any device, even when scrolling through dozens of rooms with thousands of messages, and move between Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS without giving up any features or learning a new app UI.

Matrix is an open protocol for secure, decentralized chat and other communication, built with privacy at its core. Instead of trusting one company with all of your messages, you create an account on a homeserver of your choice, run by a community, an employer, a government, or even yourself, and talk to anyone on any other homeserver across the world. Basically, it's like email, but fully encrypted and real-time. No ads, no analytics, no data brokers.
Hepta inherits the main Matrix client features provided by Robrix:

ul.li: End-to-end encryption and verification for encrypted chat across public, private, and DM rooms
Fast login and room updates via native sliding sync
Room timelines with richly-formatted text content, images, and link previews
Spaces: explore and join rooms and sub-spaces
Editing messages, without losing your draft
Replies: inline previews, and sending replies
Rooms: joining and leaving, sending and receiving invites, knocking
Offline mode with a persistent local event cache
Login to supported homeservers via SSO or username and password

description.p: Hepta retains the MIT license and full Robrix attribution.
Hepta is under active development. Not all features are complete yet, including some room administration and media playback workflows.
